why: Analysis 1 matches the key's hedgehog more exactly (profit per active SKU, durable hero products, innovation serving usefulness) and names resin pass-through to powerful retailers as the weakest link, while both cover the stop-doing items, brutal facts and decline stages about equally. Analysis 2 has the tighter verdict, an explicit confidence statement and makes order fill the weakest link, but its shelf-foot denominator is a step further from the key.
